overview: Built an automated SEO content system that generates, checks, and improves articles against NeuronWriter guidelines.
The system takes keywords from Google Sheets, gathers the required SEO information, generates the content, checks the score, and continues refining it until the target score is reached.

blocks.p: The process starts with primary and secondary keywords stored in Google Sheets.

list: Retrieves SEO guidelines and content requirements
Generates structured content with the required headings and topic coverage
Sends the content back for scoring
Checks the SEO score against the target
Automatically improves the content when the score is below target
Saves the final content and SEO data in Google Sheets

result: A repeatable SEO content pipeline that reduces manual optimization, speeds up content production, and consistently works toward the required NeuronWriter score without having to manually review and revise every article.
